text:
incident-bot: :warning: ALERT: elevated token accounting delta for tenant=NorthStar-Finance (vpc-dedicated-ns1). Threshold breached: +48% tokens vs expected in the last 30m. Paging #oncall @Joe Ramos.
Alex Kim: Joe are you able to pick this up? Customer on Dedicated pool, we've got increased latency earlier but now billing team sees a token spike. Possible double-counting in metering pipeline.
Joe Ramos: I'm on it, grabbing context. Mira, can you drop the metering ingestion link? :pager:
Mira Patel: https://grafana.redwood/alerts/1842503456 - shows a sharp step at 10:12 UTC. Metering-aggregator logs show repeated opaque_request_id values.
Sam O'Neill: hitting this too. For clarity: NorthStar is on vpc-dedicated-ns1, model pinned to rwd-closed-1.2-quant. No model deploy around that time. We did a capacity failover in that pool at 09:58 for a kernel update — that might be correlated.
Alex Kim: Important to confirm customer impact before doing mitigations. Lia, billing - can you confirm whether invoices already computed or we're talking about in-flight meter data?
Lia Chen: invoices not finalized yet. This is near-real-time token tallies. If double-counting persisted for ~30m, exposure is significant. Putting an interim billing hold for NorthStar until we reconcile. Will coordinate notifications.
Edgar Ruiz: Quick check of metering-aggregator logs:
```
2026-03-15T10:12:03Z INFO ingest tenant=NorthStar request_id=6f1a3c shard=5 tokens=142
2026-03-15T10:12:03Z INFO ingest tenant=NorthStar request_id=6f1a3c shard=5 tokens=142
2026-03-15T10:12:04Z WARN dedupe_failed tenant=NorthStar request_id=6f1a3c
```
Edgar Ruiz: looks like the dedupe layer failed to mark the second event as duplicate. The request_id is identical — suggests upstream replay or a race in the dedupe cache after failover.
Mira Patel: I also see the streaming router retried some requests to fallback nodes at 09:58 due to the kernel update. Retries didn't carry through the dedupe header X-Request-ID in some cases.
Joe Ramos: Action plan starting now:
  1) Stop aggregator writes for NorthStar (set tenant_write=false) to avoid further double counts.
  2) Re-enable strict dedupe TTL and bump cache size on metering-aggregator.
  3) Run offline reconciliation to compute true token usage and produce delta report.
  4) Notify customer and place billing hold until reconciled.
Alex Kim: I can flip tenant_write=false. Command I'm going to run:
```
# disable writes for tenant
curl -XPOST "https://internal-api.redwood/tenants/NorthStar/flags" -d '{"metering_write":false}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN'
```
Mira Patel: Sam - can you validate the router will still serve tokens (reads) but not emit writes? We need customer UX kept for low-latency requests.
Sam O'Neill: Confirmed. Router will continue to proxy inference; only billing emission is gated. I tested a canary with tenant_write=false earlier, requests succeeded.
Lia Chen: I've put a temporary billing hold and flagged CS to prepare client messaging. Priya, please draft a short note: acknowledging we've detected anomalous token accounting, we halted billing writes, and will follow up with reconciliation and credit timeline.
Priya Rao: On it. Draft:
"Hi NorthStar team — we observed anomalous token reporting tied to a failover in your dedicated pool. We've temporarily paused billing writes to prevent incorrect charges. We'll reconcile and follow up within 24 hours with details and any credits. Apologies for the disruption."
Alex Kim: Good. Next technical step: reconciliation. Edgar, Mira can you run the reconcile job using raw ingest logs and dedupe by request_id + timestamp window? Use this command:
```
python tools/reconcile_tokens.py --tenant NorthStar --since 2026-03-15T09:50Z --until 2026-03-15T10:20Z --dedupe-key request_id --output /tmp/ns_recon.csv
```
Edgar Ruiz: Running now. ETA ~7m (scan of 6h log shards). I'll attach CSV and quick diff of counted vs emitted.
Mira Patel: Preliminary scan shows about 47% of the spike rows share duplicated request_id across shards 4-6. Likely the router retried without propagating dedupe headers after failover.
Joe Ramos: If confirmed, mitigation is patching router to always include X-Request-ID on retries and to bump dedupe cache TTL to 10m to tolerate bursts during failover.
Sam O'Neill: Can we push a quick config change rather than a code deploy? We have runtime flag to force-add missing request IDs based on client_id+seq when header missing. Risk: small chance of false merges. Recommend enable for 30m window.
Alex Kim: Let's enable runtime fallback, and schedule a proper fix for tomorrow.
Lia Chen: After reconciliation, we'll compute credit = sum(double_counted_tokens) * rate. Need CSV with columns: request_id, tokens_emitted, tokens_actual, delta.
Edgar Ruiz: Reconcile job complete. Summary (first pass):
```
rows_scanned: 124,512
rows_deduped: 58,932
tokens_emitted: 18,452,210
tokens_true: 9,917,864
apparent_overcount: 8,534,346 (46.2%)
```
Edgar Ruiz: attaching /tmp/ns_recon.csv (uploaded to incident drive). I'll also run SQL reconciliation against billing_ledger for the same window:
```
SELECT request_id, SUM(tokens) as emitted_tokens
FROM billing_events
WHERE tenant='NorthStar' AND ts BETWEEN '2026-03-15 09:50' AND '2026-03-15 10:20'
GROUP BY request_id;
```
Mira Patel: Cross-check shows billing_events mirror the aggregator emits (i.e., duplicates made it into ledger). Lia, ledger corrections needed.
Lia Chen: I'll coordinate a ledger adjustment job to mark duplicate rows as reversed and issue credits. Need exact list of invoice_ids impacted.
Priya Rao: Customer comms updated: added expected timeline for credits within 48 hours and offer of a call. Customer replied: "Thanks, please confirm when billing is paused and what impact this has on inference latency." — they are worried about performance.
Sam O'Neill: No latency impact; we didn't block inference. Only billing writes paused. Tell them requests are normal.
Joe Ramos: Follow-ups:
  - Short patch: enable runtime fallback for missing X-Request-ID (Sam) — done at 10:36 UTC.
  - Bump dedupe cache TTL to 10m and increase cache size (Mira) — done at 10:40 UTC.
  - Billing hold placed and customer notified (Lia/Priya) — done.
  - Reconciliation CSV produced and ledger fix plan scheduled (Edgar/Lia) — in progress.
Alex Kim: Postmortem owners? Mira + Edgar to lead, Lia to own billing remediation and customer credits, Priya to own communication. We'll include timeline and root cause: router retries after dedicated pool failover stripped dedupe header -> dedupe layer couldn't detect duplicates -> duplicate emits into billing ledger.
Priya Rao: I'll draft the incident summary and send to NorthStar and internal execs after ledger corrections are scheduled.
Joe Ramos: Closing note: no ongoing customer impact to inference, billing exposure isolated to the window 09:58-10:12. Reopen this thread if reconciliation reveals additional edge cases.
Alex Kim: Thanks all. :thumbsup:
